title: Shibby Live AMA : 2017 (ORIGINAL)
description: When I came across my old "Ask Me Anything" AMA posts the other day, and realised I'd never shared it here before, well, I just knew I had to fix that. Those listeners who are new, or missed out on this the first time around, I thought you might appreciate learning a little bit more about erotic hypnosis and real life kink from my own perspective and experiences. I can't promise to be nice, but I do promise you'll have fun... This is the back-up live version, as is, with all the pauses, the "uhhs" and "ahhs", and everything else picked up by all our microphones in the background. It was first recorded back in the 21st of April in 2017, and now for the first time I've re-released it in an audio-only format. Come listen in and enjoy some of the more interesting and provocative questions I was posed. Social Media With the live event ongoing, I also set up and created my own social media account @SaysShibby on the platform then known as Twitter.
